title: converge-session-lease-smoothing-and-adaptive-retry-presets-across-py-ts-go
author: Nina K. Rao
description: Motivation: We have drift between Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs in how session leases, heartbeat windows, and retry profiles interact with streaming consumers which causes user-visible reconnects under transient auth flaps and inconsistent backoff behavior across runtimes. This PR introduces a coordinated, ergonomics-focused change set that (1) smooths session-lease jitter by introducing a lease window sampler and coordinated preemptive refresh, (2) adds adaptive retry presets that select backoff weightings based on latency SLOs and token budget hints, (3) normalizes pause/resume semantics for pull/push streaming APIs and adds a lightweight pullstream adapter to each SDK, (4) bumps SDK versions and documents migration steps. The change preserves backwards compatibility for the majority of callers; where behavior changes are possible we add explicit opt-in flags and migration notes. The PR also includes telemetry keys for retry-classification and session-heartbeat events so customers can correlate retries with lease expirations. Related work: ENG-2190 customer incident analysis and ENG-2233 cross-sdk parity roadmap. Implementation detail highlights: lease sampler runs in-process and issues a pre-refresh at 30-55% of remaining TTL with jitter that is coordinated with the transport's heartbeat jitter to avoid thundering renewals; adaptive retry presets expose three named profiles (latency-optimised, cost-optimised, conservative) and a predicate that uses median p95 latency and remaining token quota to pick weights. We introduce a compact pullstream-lite adapter that implements pause(), resume(), and checkpoint() primitives with identical semantics across languages. Version bumps: python 2.8.0 -> 2.9.0, typescript 1.27.0 -> 1.28.0, go v1.8.0 -> v1.9.0. Release notes and migration guide added to docs/sdk-migration/lease-and-retries.md. Testing: unit tests added for lease sampler edge cases, interop smoke tests for pause/resume, and integration tests that simulate auth flaps and verify no double-refresh storm. Rollout: feature gated behind SDK config flag "enable_unified_lease" and a server-side opt-in.

release_notes: Introduce unified session lease smoothing and adaptive retry presets across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. Default behavior unchanged unless 'enable_unified_lease' is enabled. Adds pullstream-lite adapter to normalize stream pause/resume/checkpoint semantics. SDK versions bumped: python->2.9.0, typescript->1.28.0, go->v1.9.0. See docs/sdk-migration/lease-and-retries.md for migration notes and telemetry keys.
summary: Cross-SDK ergonomics and parity work to reduce auth-related reconnects and improve retry behavior while exposing ergonomic presets for developers.
